title: anthyllis dillenii subsp. praepropera
intro: Anthyllis dillenii subsp. praepropera, commonly known as Kidney vetch, is a plant species in the legume family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Anthyllis dillenii subsp. praepropera include treating urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
